title: Inspection of the Wing Lower Cover Spanwise Splice Joints

ata.title: Wing Box Structure — Lower Cover Panels

abstract: Airworthiness limitation inspection of the wing lower cover spanwise splice joints from inside the tank, with the fastener head protrusion criterion and the eddy current coverage at the first fastener row.

sections.purpose: This task gives the airworthiness limitation inspection of the spanwise splice joints in the wing lower cover, done from inside the tank at the inboard and mid splice positions.
sections.job_setup_note: This is an airworthiness limitation task. The tank must be defuelled, purged and certified safe for entry, with entry control and a standby person in place. Allow for a full shift of ventilation before entry. Take the protrusion measurements with the depth micrometer on the same three head positions at each splice so that successive inspections are comparable.
sections.procedure: 1. Defuel the tank and do the purge procedure. 2. Get the tank entry certificate from the responsible person. WARNING: DO NOT ENTER THE TANK UNTIL THE ENTRY CERTIFICATE IS ISSUED AND THE STANDBY PERSON IS IN POSITION. 3. Open the lower access panels in zones 532 and 633. 4. Continue the forced ventilation for the full time given in the standard practice. 5. Clean the splice joint and remove the sealant fillet locally where the illustration shows it. 6. Do a detailed visual inspection of the splice strap INN928999-53 along the first fastener row. 7. Measure the head protrusion at the three marked positions of each splice. The installed head must stand no more than 0.08 mm proud of the strap surface; anything above that figure is recorded as a finding and reported. 8. Do a detailed visual inspection of the interface frame D5710120386639 and of the lower stiffener D5710123576997. 9. Do an eddy current inspection of the first fastener row at each splice position. CAUTION: DO NOT REMOVE A FASTENER TO IMPROVE THE EDDY CURRENT ACCESS. THE JOINT IS SEALED WET AND A REMOVED FASTENER NEEDS A FULL RE-SEAL. 10. Record every indication with its rib number and its fastener position. 11. Restore the sealant fillet where it was removed. 12. Close the access panels after the leak check.
sections.close_out: Record the inspection result against the airworthiness limitation task in the aircraft maintenance record, with the fastener standard used to select the threshold. Refuel and do a leak check of both access panels. Report any indication to the operator engineering organisation before the aircraft is released.

type_data.effectivity_note: All aircraft. Threshold 24 000 flight cycles. One protrusion acceptance figure applies and it is given in step 7.

safety_precautions: Do not enter the tank without a valid entry certificate.
Keep a standby person outside the access panel at all times.
Keep the forced ventilation running for the whole task.

title: Inspection of the Wing Lower Cover Spanwise Splice Joints

issue.reason: Second head protrusion acceptance figure issued under a post-modification effectivity condition, together with the revised threshold for the cold-worked joints.

ata.title: Wing Box Structure — Lower Cover Panels

abstract: Airworthiness limitation inspection of the wing lower cover spanwise splice joints from inside the tank, with the two thresholds and the two head protrusion figures that apply to the clearance-fit and the interference-fit fastener standards.

sections.purpose: This task gives the airworthiness limitation inspection of the spanwise splice joints in the wing lower cover, done from inside the tank at the inboard and mid splice positions.
sections.job_setup_note: This is an airworthiness limitation task and both the threshold and the head protrusion acceptance figure depend on the fastener standard of the individual aircraft. Establish the standard from the aircraft configuration record before you plan the visit, because the two thresholds differ by twelve thousand flight cycles and the two acceptance figures differ by four hundredths of a millimetre. The tank must be defuelled, purged and certified safe for entry, with entry control and a standby person in place. Allow for a full shift of ventilation before entry. Take the protrusion measurements with the depth micrometer on the same three head positions at each splice so that successive inspections are comparable.
sections.procedure: 1. Defuel the tank and do the purge procedure. 2. Get the tank entry certificate from the responsible person. WARNING: DO NOT ENTER THE TANK UNTIL THE ENTRY CERTIFICATE IS ISSUED AND THE STANDBY PERSON IS IN POSITION. 3. Open the lower access panels in zones 532 and 633. 4. Continue the forced ventilation for the full time given in the standard practice. 5. Clean the splice joint and remove the sealant fillet locally where the illustration shows it. 6. Do a detailed visual inspection of the splice strap INN928999-53 along the first fastener row. 7. Measure the head protrusion at the three marked positions of each splice and read the result against the figure for the fastener standard installed. On a pre MOD-161688 aircraft the clearance-fit head must stand no more than 0.08 mm proud of the strap surface. On a post MOD-161688 aircraft the cold-worked interference-fit fastener AGS17834-4B sits marginally higher by design and the acceptance figure is 0.12 mm; a head between 0.08 mm and 0.12 mm on that standard is the delivered condition and is not a finding. CAUTION: DO NOT READ THE 0.08 MM FIGURE ON A POST MOD-161688 SPLICE. EVERY JOINT INSPECTED WILL BE REPORTED AS A FINDING AND THE TANK WILL BE REOPENED FOR NOTHING. 8. Do a detailed visual inspection of the interface frame D5710120386639 and of the lower stiffener D5710123576997. 9. Do an eddy current inspection of the first fastener row at each splice position. CAUTION: DO NOT REMOVE A FASTENER TO IMPROVE THE EDDY CURRENT ACCESS. THE JOINT IS SEALED WET AND A REMOVED FASTENER NEEDS A FULL RE-SEAL. 10. Record every indication with its rib number and its fastener position. 11. Restore the sealant fillet where it was removed. 12. Close the access panels after the leak check.
sections.close_out: Record the inspection result against the airworthiness limitation task in the aircraft maintenance record, with the fastener standard used to select both the threshold and the protrusion figure. Refuel and do a leak check of both access panels. Report any indication to the operator engineering organisation before the aircraft is released.

type_data.effectivity_note: Pre MOD-161688 aircraft: threshold 24 000 flight cycles, head protrusion acceptance 0.08 mm. Post MOD-161688 aircraft: threshold 36 000 flight cycles for the cold-worked joints, head protrusion acceptance 0.12 mm. Neither figure may be read across to the other standard.

safety_precautions: Do not enter the tank without a valid entry certificate.
Keep a standby person outside the access panel at all times.
Keep the forced ventilation running for the whole task.
